newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Borsodchem hits new high, market mixed.
newsitem.headline: Borsodchem hits new high, market mixed.

text.p: Shares in Hungarian chemicals company Borsodchem outperformed a mixed market in early trading on Wednesday and jumped to a new record high of 6,705 forints.

Borsodchem opened at 6,450 forints, barely changed from Tuesday's close of 6,460 forints, and rapidly rose to record territory and reached a new high of 6,705. At 1118 GMT Borsodchem traded at 6,650 forints.

"There isn't any news on Borsodchem, but I heard the market is talking about about one or two reports which recommended it as a 'buy," one trader said, adding that mostly foreigners were buying the stock.
Reuters has not received any reports on Borsodchem in the past few days.

However, in the February issue of its Eastern European Monthly ING Barings raised its 1997 earnings per share forecast for the company to 989 forints from 810 forints. At the same time it raised Borsodchem's recommendation to 'buy' from 'long-term buy.'
